# Sample Project

Sample Project helps agents check a tiny library before they ship it.

## Overview

It reads a file and prints a one-line summary. The summary is meant for a quick review.

## Installation

Install it with the language tools you already have. You need Python 3.11 or newer on PATH.

## Usage

Run the check command on a file. It prints one line and then exits.

## Warnings

Do not point it at private keys. The tool reads local files as the user who launched it.
